item.title: Teen daughter of a Chicago man detained in an immigration case dies from a rare cancer
item.description: CHICAGO (AP) — A Chicago teen who spoke out for her father’s release after he was detained last fall by immigration officials in a deportation case has died after battling a rare form of cancer. item.title: Indian Health Service to phase out use of dental fillings containing mercury by 2027
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (AP) — The federal agency that provides health care to Native Americans and Alaska Natives has announced it will phase out the use of dental fillings containing mercury.
